decisions.reason: This yogurt is very close to the firm's established dairy capabilities and has already shown external market validation, so the firm can learn from it and improve it with little new knowledge required.
As a prominently positioned cheese variant built directly on core cheese know-how, it fits the firm's knowledge base and strategic direction, making withdrawal unlikely.
The semi-hard cheese wheel remains strongly related to existing cheese expertise, but its more standard profile and lower visibility make it somewhat more exposed to portfolio pruning.
This mild creamy soft cheese extends the existing cheese range in a familiar way, so the firm has high absorptive capacity to interpret demand and refine it rather than drop it.

Washed-rind soft cheese is still within the firm's competence base, but its greater production and acceptance complexity means it carries the highest ongoing withdrawal risk among the remaining products.
